response.text:
Information for Exhibitors - League of Minnesota Cities

## We can’t wait to see you at the 2026 LMC Annual Conference exhibit hall!

The 2026 exhibit hall is sold out. If you would like to be added to the waitlist for a booth in the event there are any cancellations, or if you would like to learn about other sponsorship opportunities, contact us as exhibit@lmc.org.

Annual Conference: Wednesday, June 24 – Friday, June 26 Mayo Civic Center – Rochester, MN

Exhibit hall open: Wednesday, June 24, 3:30 p.m. – 6:30 p.m.

Reach city leaders at the premier event for Minnesota cities. Exhibit at the LMC Annual Conference to:

- Make new contacts and strengthen existing relationships.
- Connect with mayors, council members, administrators, and other city staff during the three hour can’t-miss kick-off celebration in the exhibit hall.
- Explore hot topics and understand more about the issues and challenges facing cities when you attend the conference session and network with attendees.
